snippet.title: First 8 MINUTES of the DEMO | Kirugakuen
snippet.description:
♥ ♠ ♦ ♣ JOIN THE KIRUGAKUEN DISCORD SERVER: https://discord.gg/M7Cf6GKc9P 

Enjoy the first 8 minutes from Kirugakuen. This is a short gameplay preview for the upcoming DEMO of Kirugakuen, recorded straight from the game. Get ready, everything will begin soon...

Play the PLAYABLE PREVIEW here: https://danganfran.itch.io/kirugakuen

♥️♠️♦️♣️

Kirugakuen is a new and fresh killing game concept surrounded by horror, poker and showtime themes. Unveil all the mysteries of The Academy, and most importantly, win!

Follow development on X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/kirugakuen
